non_defects.claim: Dropping the unconditional `_rg "$@"` breaks normal fpath/compinit completion.
non_defects.ruling: False: $funcstack[1] == _rg is true precisely on the autoload dispatch path (observed as (_rg _rg) at load), so the branch taken there is identical to the old unconditional call; the invocation counter shows exactly one call.

non_defects.claim: compdef might not be the right call or might not exist when needed.
non_defects.ruling: The `(( ! $+functions[compdef] ))` half of the guard falls back to the old call when compdef is undefined; compdef is the documented zshcompsys API and leaves ${_comps[rg]} = _rg, the same registration compinit produces.
It is the form the zsh-completion expert okdana recommended in review, replacing a `type compdef` draft the repository's own CI rejected; idiomatic zsh.

non_defects.claim: Referencing $funcstack[1] under setopt no_unset aborts when funcstack is empty.
non_defects.ruling: True only for a bare top-level evaluation that never occurs on this code path; under `source <(...)` or `eval "$(...)"` the source/eval frame is already on the stack. Confirmed by experiment.

non_defects.claim: The FAQ's added fpath step is scope creep.
non_defects.ruling: okdana flagged on this PR that the pre-existing zsh instructions never told the user to add the directory to fpath; the head commit's rewrite repairs that deliberately and in scope.

non_defects.claim: The FAQ's slower-startup claim (~4 ms) is unsubstantiated.
non_defects.ruling: Hedged by the maintainer in the merge comment and directionally uncontroversial (fork/exec of rg on every shell start versus a cached static file); a benchmark request would be a hygiene nit.

non_defects.claim: There is a redundant or awkward sentence in the FAQ ('is easier to setup, is generally slower...').

clean_basis: cargo build --release and ./ci/test-complete pass identically at the merge-base and the head (that script sources the file with _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 and diffs option names against rg --help; it does not exercise the funcstack/compdef branch). The new branch was verified directly: sourcing the old file under compinit reproduces issue #2956's error (`_arguments:comparguments:327: can only be called from completion function`, exit 1); sourcing the new file exits 0 and registers _rg for rg; the fpath/autoload path is unaffected and invokes _rg exactly once. The ground-truth surface a correct review must not assert as a defect is the replacement of the unconditional `_rg "$@"` by the funcstack/compdef guard.
